Transport plays video now.

## Video
- Open or drop a video like any track. The picture takes the place of the plugin area below the waveform, with a soft crossfade.
- The sound plays through Transport's own audio path, so the **waveform, every meter and analyzer, and the EQ / compressor / limiter** work on a film's soundtrack exactly as on music.
- Picture and sound stay in sync: the audio is the clock, and the picture follows it, compensating for the audio device's latency. Seeking, looping (A–B) and skipping all just work.
- **Click** the picture to play/pause, **double-click** or **F** for full screen (title, time and a seek bar appear when you move the mouse), **Esc** to leave.
- **V**, the ▦ button on the picture, or MENU → *Show video* switch between the video and your plugins. Effects keep running either way.
- A frame from the video becomes the cover in the header and the taskbar mini player.
- Phone videos shot upright show upright; non-square pixels are corrected.
- Header shows the codec, resolution and frame rate (e.g. `MP4 · H.264 · 1920×1080 · 25 fps · AAC 48 kHz`).
- New quick-access functions: *Video / plugins* and *Full screen video*.

Uses the decoder that comes with the system, so the app stays self-contained:

| | Formats |
|---|---|
| Windows (Media Foundation) | MP4, MOV, M4V, MKV, AVI, WMV, 3GP |
| macOS (AVFoundation) | MP4, MOV, M4V, 3GP |
| Linux (FFmpeg) | the above plus WebM, FLV, MPEG, TS, OGV |

H.264 works everywhere. HEVC, VP9 and AV1 depend on the OS version and installed codec extensions.

## Also
- **Windows:** M4A and AAC files now open too (they didn't before).
- **Windows:** Transport appears under "Open with" for videos (it does not make itself the default video player).

## Downloads
| Platform | File | How to start |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `Transport-Windows-x64.exe` | Just run it, nothing to install. SmartScreen: *More info → Run anyway* (not code-signed yet). |
| macOS 11+ (Apple Silicon & Intel) | `Transport-macOS.zip` | Unzip, right-click → **Open** the first time (not notarised yet). |
| Linux x64 | `Transport-Linux-x64.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./Transport`. Video needs the system FFmpeg libraries. |
